# Vulkan-Headers

Version 1.4.321, commit `4c8aa84a61c12cab9780fa44298617666b491d71`, from [KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/tree/v1.4.321).

The original headers and license files are included directly. No download is required. The CMake target exposes them privately to the Vulkan backend. See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md) and [LICENSES](LICENSES) for license terms.
